intro.quote: The X.509 v3 certificate basic syntax is as follows. For signature calculation, the data that is to be signed is encoded using the ASN.1 distinguished encoding rules (DER) [X.690]. ASN.1 DER encoding is a tag, length, value encoding system for each element.

fields.name: tbsCertificate
fields.explain: Holds the names of the subject and issuer, a subject public key, a validity period, and other associated certificate information.

cite.quote: The field contains the names of the subject and issuer, a public key associated with the subject, a validity period, and other associated information. The fields are described in detail in Section 4.1.2; the tbsCertificate usually includes extensions, which are described in Section 4.2.

fields.name: signatureAlgorithm
fields.explain: Identifies the cryptographic algorithm used by the CA to sign the certificate.

cite.quote: The signatureAlgorithm field contains the identifier for the cryptographic algorithm used by the CA to sign this certificate.

fields.name: signatureValue
fields.explain: Contains the digital signature computed over the DER-encoded tbsCertificate.

cite.quote: The signatureValue field contains a digital signature computed upon the ASN.1 DER encoded tbsCertificate.

intro.quote: The sequence TBSCertificate contains information associated with the subject of the certificate and the CA that issued it.

fields.name: version
fields.explain: Identifies the encoded certificate version and defaults to v1 when omitted.

cite.quote: version [0] EXPLICIT Version DEFAULT v1,

fields.name: serialNumber
fields.explain: Carries the CA-assigned serial number that identifies a certificate within the issuer's sequence.

cite.quote: The serial number MUST be a positive integer assigned by the CA to each certificate. It MUST be unique for each certificate issued by a given CA (i.e., the issuer name and serial number identify a unique certificate). CAs MUST force the serialNumber to be a non-negative integer.

fields.name: signature
fields.explain: Identifies the algorithm used by the CA to sign the certificate.

cite.quote:
4.1.2.3.  Signature

   This field contains the algorithm identifier for the algorithm used
   by the CA to sign the certificate.

fields.name: issuer
fields.explain: Identifies the entity that signed and issued the certificate.

cite.quote: The issuer field identifies the entity that has signed and issued the certificate.

fields.name: validity
fields.explain: States the period during which the CA warrants that it will maintain certificate-status information.

cite.quote: The certificate validity period is the time interval during which the CA warrants that it will maintain information about the status of the certificate. The field is represented as a SEQUENCE of two dates: the date on which the certificate validity period begins (notBefore) and the date on which the certificate validity period ends (notAfter).

fields.name: subject
fields.explain: Identifies the entity associated with the certificate's public key.

cite.quote: The subject field identifies the entity associated with the public key stored in the subject public key field.

fields.name: subjectPublicKeyInfo
fields.explain: Carries the public key and identifies the algorithm with which the key is used.

cite.quote: SubjectPublicKeyInfo ::= SEQUENCE { algorithm AlgorithmIdentifier, subjectPublicKey BIT STRING }

fields.name: issuerUniqueID
fields.explain: Holds an optional issuer unique identifier; when present, the certificate version must be 2 or 3.

cite.quote: issuerUniqueID [1] IMPLICIT UniqueIdentifier OPTIONAL, -- If present, version MUST be v2 or v3

fields.name: subjectUniqueID
fields.explain: Holds an optional subject unique identifier; when present, the certificate version must be 2 or 3.

cite.quote: subjectUniqueID [2] IMPLICIT UniqueIdentifier OPTIONAL, -- If present, version MUST be v2 or v3

fields.name: extensions
fields.explain: Holds optional certificate extensions; when present, the certificate version must be 3.

cite.quote: extensions [3] EXPLICIT Extensions OPTIONAL -- If present, version MUST be v3

intro.quote: The X.509 v2 CRL syntax is as follows. For signature calculation, the data that is to be signed is ASN.1 DER encoded. ASN.1 DER encoding is a tag, length, value encoding system for each element.

fields.name: tbsCertList
fields.explain: Holds the issuer, update dates, optional revoked-certificate list, and optional CRL extensions.

cite.quote: The first field in the sequence is the tbsCertList. This field is itself a sequence containing the name of the issuer, issue date, issue date of the next list, the optional list of revoked certificates, and optional CRL extensions.

fields.name: signatureAlgorithm
fields.explain: Identifies the algorithm used by the CRL issuer to sign the CertificateList.

cite.quote: The signatureAlgorithm field contains the algorithm identifier for the algorithm used by the CRL issuer to sign the CertificateList.

fields.name: signatureValue
fields.explain: Contains the digital signature computed over the DER-encoded tbsCertList.

cite.quote: The signatureValue field contains a digital signature computed upon the ASN.1 DER encoded tbsCertList.

intro.quote: The certificate list to be signed, or TBSCertList, is a sequence of required and optional fields. The required fields identify the CRL issuer, the algorithm used to sign the CRL, and the date and time the CRL was issued. Optional fields include the date and time by which the CRL issuer will issue the next CRL, lists of revoked certificates, and CRL extensions.

fields.name: version
fields.explain: Identifies the CRL version; version 2 is required when extensions are used.

cite.quote: This optional field describes the version of the encoded CRL. When extensions are used, as required by this profile, this field MUST be present and MUST specify version 2 (the integer value is 1).

fields.name: signature
fields.explain: Identifies the algorithm used by the CRL issuer to sign the CRL.

cite.quote:
5.1.2.2.  Signature

   This field contains the algorithm identifier for the algorithm used
   to sign the CRL.

fields.name: issuer
fields.explain: Identifies the entity that signed and issued the CRL.

cite.quote: The issuer name identifies the entity that has signed and issued the CRL. The issuer identity is carried in the issuer field. Alternative name forms may also appear in the issuerAltName extension (Section 5.2.2). The issuer field MUST contain a non-empty X.500 distinguished name (DN).

fields.name: thisUpdate
fields.explain: Gives the issue date of the CRL.

cite.quote: This field indicates the issue date of this CRL. thisUpdate may be encoded as UTCTime or GeneralizedTime.

fields.name: nextUpdate
fields.explain: Gives the date by which the next CRL will be issued.

cite.quote: This field indicates the date by which the next CRL will be issued. The next CRL could be issued before the indicated date, but it will not be issued any later than the indicated date. CRL issuers SHOULD issue CRLs with a nextUpdate time equal to or later than all previous CRLs. nextUpdate may be encoded as UTCTime or GeneralizedTime.

fields.name: revokedCertificates
fields.explain: Holds an optional list of revoked-certificate entries.

cite.quote: revokedCertificates SEQUENCE OF SEQUENCE {

fields.name: crlExtensions
fields.explain: Holds optional CRL extensions; when present, the CRL must be version 2.

cite.quote: crlExtensions [0] EXPLICIT Extensions OPTIONAL -- if present, version MUST be v2
